source_text: Critiques of anti-circumcision advocacy, often referred to as intactivism, center on its reliance on low-quality evidence, selective interpretation of data, and unsubstantiated claims that contradict high-quality scientific studies supporting the procedure's benefits and minimal risks. [153]
